section_summary.extract_value: This section details the various measures employed in a single study. It describes a newly developed humor production test (HPT) with three humor categories, a self-report humor production ability scale, and divergent thinking tasks (alternate uses and instances). Intelligence was assessed using measures of fluid intelligence (Culture Fair Test 3) and crystallized intelligence (Wilde-Intelligence-Test), and creative achievement was measured with the German version of the Inventory of Creative Activities and Achievements (ICAA).
